paper.title: Execution-Reference Encoding and Recovery-Aware Collection for GPU Profiling

projects.name: ERETrace
projects.title_zh: 让细粒度 GPU 追踪，成为可负担的日常工具。
projects.desc_zh: 利用执行上下文中的参考关系，无损表示细粒度记录；将编码、受检 raw 回退与有界异步采集结合，在完整推理过程中降低采集成本。
projects.desc_en: Lossless execution-reference encoding, checked raw fallback, and bounded asynchronous collection reduce the cost of fine-grained tracing during complete inference requests.
items_zh: SM / CTA 参考编码与精确恢复
完整请求计时与 trace 文件体积评估
复现配置、公开数据与独立正确性验证
items_en: SM / CTA references and exact recovery
Reproduction configs, public data, and separate correctness checks

projects.name: HeteroQuantServeBench
projects.title_zh: 从算子到服务，组织可追溯的推理优化。
projects.title_en: An evidence trail from kernels to serving.
projects.desc_zh: 面向 CUDA 与 Ascend/CANN 的推理实验项目。围绕模型基线、算子替换、量化、KV cache、运行时与原生推理引擎，连接 Web 工作台和真实运行记录。
projects.desc_en: An inference experimentation project targeting CUDA and Ascend/CANN. A web console connects model baselines, kernel substitutions, quantization, KV-cache policies, runtimes, and native inference engines to recorded runs.
items_zh: 运行配置、生效凭据与质量对照
内存 / 数据流 / kernel 诊断与运行关联
项目仍在迭代，各模块支持范围见仓库
items_en: Run configurations, execution evidence, and quality comparisons
Memory, dataflow, and kernel diagnostics linked to runs
Active development; module support is documented in the repository

projects.name: Activation Functions Hub
projects.title_zh: 整理激活函数的公式、直觉与使用线索。
projects.title_en: A starting point for activation functions.
projects.desc_zh: 面向深度学习激活函数的公开资料项目，关注数学表达、直观理解与 PyTorch 使用。当前公开仓库提供项目介绍，内容持续整理。
projects.desc_en: A public resource project on deep-learning activation functions, with an emphasis on formulas, intuition, and PyTorch usage. The public repository currently provides the project overview; the collection is ongoing.
items_zh: 以仓库实际公开内容为准
items_en: Available content is reflected in the public repository
